verdict.rationale: Vestd documents option grants, share issuance and board-ready governance, but only as in-app workflows. The pack has no evidence of an API or other programmatic surface an agent could use to draft grants and queue them for board approval. The OpenAPI probes all returned 404, and llms.txt and the HRIS integration are adjacent features, not a drafting API with an approval queue.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can draft securities (e.g. option grants) via the platform's programmatic surface and leave them queued for human board approval
